extraction_text: All guy and stiff leg derricks when used in erecting structural steel work shall be manned by six (6) men and a pusher (assistant Foreman) unless the derrick is turned by a mechanical device, in which case such derrick may be manned by five (5) men. On the erection of steel where a crane is used, a minimum of five (5) men and a Foreman shall be used, with one (1) man designated as a signal man, provided, however, for the erection on buildings of two (2) floors or less of structural steel, with the use of a hydraulic type rig with telescoping boom such as a cherry picker, not exceeding thirty-five (35) tons maximum capacity, a minimum of four (4) men plus a Foreman may be used.
